vs -y for the placement\\n- [Use short low contact to seat an upright object after an off-center release](global/low-contact-seat-after-release.md) \\u2014 An object is already upright on the intended surface but the On predicate did not fire after release\\n- [Use a low regrasp to settle an object that is already on the target.](global/low-pose-settle-regrasp.md) \\u2014 An object has been released partly on the correct target surface but the official predicate has not fired.\\n- [Grasp a moka pot by its thin side handle, not its wide body or cap](global/moka-pot-grasp-the-handle-not-the-body.md) \\u2014 picking a moka pot (or any wide low-poly pot/kettle with a slim handle) when top-down body grasps stall and Pi0 will not close\\n- [Disambiguate a \\\"back/front compartment\\\" by finding the divided front/back PAIR, not by absolute depth](global/named-compartment-via-front-back-pair.md) \\u2014 task names a \\\"back\\\" or \\\"front\\\" compartment of a multi-cell container (caddy/organizer/tray)\\n- [Use short local regrasp contact after visible near-goal placement stalls.](global/near-goal-contact-regrasp.md) \\u2014 A movable object is visibly on or partly on the target surface after release, but the task predicate is still false and open-gripper pushes risk losing control.\\n- [Use a short pick as corrective contact after a near-miss placement.](global/near-miss-corrective-pick.md) \\u2014 An object has been released partly on or against the destination surface, visual overlap is close, and scripted pushes have poor seating authority.\\n- [Use a short local repick when an upright object lands just short of a placement predicate](global/near-target-repick.md) \\u2014 A placed object remains upright adjacent to the correct target surface after release, and Pi0 can start from a close low pose\\n- [Place flat grocery boxes into baskets by targeting the liner interior.](global/object-frame-box-to-basket.md) \\u2014 Object-frame task asks for a flat box or carton to be placed in a basket\\n- [Retreat open after container release when the object is visibly inside.](global/open-retreat-settles-container.md) \\u2014 Container placement release opens the gripper but the predicate does not fire immediately while the object appears inside or wedged near the gripper\\n- [Shift bowl grasps away from nearby fixture clutter.](global/open-side-bowl-grasp.md) \\u2014 A bowl target is crowded by a cabinet handle, rim, wall, or other fixture on one side and Pi0 contacts without lifting.\\n- [Grasp a tall wide-mouth mug by its handle, not from above](global/pi0-grasp-tall-mug-by-handle.md) \\u2014 picking a tall mug/cup whose open top is wider than the gripper, where pi0_pick keeps descending into the cup and grabbing air\\n- [Judge a pi0_pick by grip + wrist, not the success flag \\u2014 it can grasp then carry past the lift check](global/pi0-pick-carries-past-lift-judge-by-grip.md) \\u2014 pi0_pick returns success:false (descent_done:false) but the eef has moved far from the object and the gripper is not fully closed\\n- [pi0_pick often carries the grasped object toward its trained place pose; exploit or cap it](global/pi0-pick-may-place-at-trained-left.md) \\u2014 using pi0_pick for a grasp and it lifts then drifts in +y (robot-left) instead of stopping at lift\\n- [Pre-position Pi0 over the visually identified object for simple basket drops.](global/pi0-prepositioned-simple-basket.md) \\u2014 A single grocery object must go into an open basket and Pi0's learned place behavior may already match the goal.\\n- [In multi-part tasks, do the pi0_pick grasp BEFORE any pi0_doubled contact skill, to keep a clean vertical wrist](global/pick-before-contact-skill-keeps-wrist-clean.md) \\u2014 A task needs both a grasp/place AND a contact skill (knob/button/drawer via pi0_doubled), and the grasp target is awkward (wide/smooth/round). Order the subtasks so the grasp comes first.\\n- [Release wide held objects once they overlap the container edge.](global/pitched-side-grasp-overedge-release.md) \\u2014 A wide bowl or cup collides before reaching a deep drawer or cavity target, but the predicate can accept an over-edge drop into the container.\\n- [Order multi-place tasks so nothing is carried or re-grasped over an already-placed fragile object](global/place-order-never-carry-over-placed-object.md) \\u2014 a task requires placing two or more objects and one placement (e.g. an upright mug on a plate) is easily tipped by a later carry\\n- [Switch to point prompts when text masks ignore the intended relation.](global/point-prompt-after-text-misground.md) \\u2014 A scene has duplicate objects or look-alike circular surfaces and SAM text segmentation selects the wrong instance\\n- [Rotate a held bowl after a reliable grasp to move its offset into reach](global/post-grasp-yaw-offset.md) \\u2014 A reliable Pi0 bowl grasp carries the object with a large offset that makes direct placement miss or hit the workspace edge\\n- [After releasing an object into a container, retreat the gripper straight up before judging the predicate](global/predicate-fires-after-gripper-retreat.md) \\u2014 you released a held object into/onto a target and libero_terminated is still false\\n- [Retreat the eef fully clear of a placement before concluding the predicate failed](global/predicate-gated-by-eef-proximity-retreat-clear.md) \\u2014 after a geometrically-correct place, libero_terminated stays false for many steps while the gripper hovers over the just-placed object\\n- [Recenter after pre-grasp yaw before trusting Pi0.](global/pregrasp-yaw-recenter.md) \\u2014 A pre-grasp wrist yaw is used to change a bowl or by rim/liner/other objects) and depth/segment centroids are rim-biased\\n- [Anchor duplicate-object wrist refinement to a visible relation landmark.](global/relation-anchored-wrist-refine.md) \\u2014 A task chooses one of multiple identical objects by a spatial relation, and wrist views can contain the wrong duplicate.\\n- [Select identical targets by the named spatial relation before wrist refinement](global/relation-selected-identical-object.md) \\u2014 A task contains duplicate or visually identical objects and names a relation such as on, left of, right of, between, or next to\\n- [Remeasure a held payload after every loaded servo before descending](global/remeasure-loaded-offset-before-descent.md) \\u2014 a large asymmetric object is carried by a handle and precise support   "content": "---\nid: libero-in-predicate-fires-while-grasped\nscope: global\nkind: strategy\ntitle: Test placement targets by holding the object over them and watching libero_terminated,\n  before releasing\napplies_when: an In()/On() place task where the correct destination among several\n  look-alikes is uncertain, or where releasing risks tipping/losing the object\nsymptom:\n- wrong compartment\n- which container\n- ambiguous target\n- place predicate not firing\n- cannot re-grasp\n- tipped after release\n- in predicate\nevidence:\n  cells:\n  - 10_task_t5_s0\n  attempts: 4\n  solved_seeds:\n  - 0\nconfidence: single-shot\nrelated:\n- caddy-back-is-near-robot-pocket\n---\n\n\nLIBERO In()/On() success predicates check the OBJECT'S POSE, not the gripper\nstate, so `libero_terminated` flips the moment the held object's pose satisfies\nthe region \u2014 you do NOT have to release first.\n\n**Why:** libero_terminated mirrors the BDDL goal predicate, which is a function\nof object poses only. Releasing is irrelevant to the check (confirmed: placing a\nmug in the correct caddy pocket fired while still grasped; placing/releasing in\nthree WRONG pockets never fired).\n**How to apply:**\n- To disambiguate among candidate destinations, carry the still-grasped object\n  (gripper +1) low over each candidate and read `libero_terminated` from the\n  returned state. Move to the next candidate if it stays false \u2014 no release, no\n  re-grasp, no commitment. This turns an N-way target guess into N cheap probes.\n- Only `release` after the flag is already true (or to seat a confirmed target).\n- Corollary: a non-firing predicate with a clean, low, upright placement is\n  evidence of WRONG DESTINATION, not wrong physics \u2014 switch targets first.\n- Caveat: some tasks pair In() with a \"not in gripper\"/stack-stability term; if a\n  held probe won't fire but the geometry looks perfect, release once to check.\n**Falsify:** a place task where the predicate provably requires the gripper open\n(object released) and a correctly-posed held object does NOT fire.\n**Related:** [[caddy-back-is-near-robot-pocket]]\n"
}

  "summary": "libero_goal task 2 seed 1 (\"put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet\") solved in one episode; top-level terminated==true at step 32.\n\nLocalization was fully perception-based: agentview_high + back_project identified the bottle lying flat on the table (base (-0.216,-0.068), neck (-0.355,-0.028)) and the cabinet's top plane at z=1.127 (region-mode 44k pixels, centroid (-0.009,-0.265), extending toward the robot), explicitly distinguished from the gray stove burner and the slatted wooden shelf.\n\nKey finding: a scripted top-down pinch of a table-lying bottle is impossible with this hand (pads only ~0.013 m below the tip; jaws open 0.0776 m) — the knuckles stall on the table at eef z=0.913 while the pads still close on air above the neck. So the grasp was delegated to pi0_pick(\"pick up the wine bottle\"), which lifted it by the neck (opening 0.0242); the false success flag came only from its descent heuristic. I then owned the carry: move_to waypoints at max reachable height (z~1.19) onto the cabinet top, release.\n\nThe first release landed the bottle correctly on the cabinet (verified by wrist back-projection: bottle z 1.157-1.171 on a surface at 1.126) but did not fire the predicate — its centre (0.096,-0.254) sat just outside the goal ink box (~(0.03,-0.20..-0.24) per the seed-0 reference), mainly ~5 mm too far in -y. At cabinet height a top-down neck grasp is unobstructed, so I re-grasped the cork end (qpos 0.0257 = neck diameter), slid the bottle +y/-x, and released — libero fired terminated==true.\n\nAudit and recipe JSONL written to the episode directory."
}

I then owned the carry: move_to waypoints at max reachable height (z~1.19) onto the cabinet top, release.\n\nThe first release landed the bottle correctly on the cabinet (verified by wrist back-projection: bottle z 1.157-1.171 on a surface at 1.126) but did not fire the predicate \u2014 its centre (0.096,-0.254) sat just outside the goal ink box (~(0.03,-0.20..-0.24) per the seed-0 reference), mainly ~5 mm too far in -y. At cabinet height a top-down neck grasp is unobstructed, so I re-grasped the cork end (qpos 0.0257 = neck diameter), slid the bottle +y/-x, and released \u2014 libero fired terminated==true.\n\nAudit and recipe JSONL written to the episode directory."
}
